Title: EVT-OP-014: Tail heaviness and the accuracy of the discrepancy method
Labels: open-problem, area:statistics, type:research, difficulty:hard, status:research

**Status in the survey:** OPEN-EXPLICIT, narrow.

## Source and quote
Markovich and Rodionov, arXiv:2009.02318:

> The impact of the heaviness of tail on the accuracy of the discrepancy method remains an open problem.

The quote was extracted from the source text, with symbols flattened; check it against the published version before citing.

## Why it matters
The discrepancy method is one way to select the threshold when estimating the extremal index.

## What the library already has
Extremal-index estimators; no discrepancy method.

## What is missing
A definition of the discrepancy method and any accuracy theory.
